models.headline: Gemini 4 Argon announced for complex reasoning work
models.summary: Google introduced Gemini 4 Argon for software engineering, knowledge work and cyber defense, rolling out first to trusted testers.

models.headline: Anthropic releases Claude Sonnet 5.5
models.summary: Anthropic says Sonnet 5.5 runs about 30 percent faster and costs up to 30 percent less than Sonnet 5 for most work.

models.headline: Google adds Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS and Flash-Lite TTS
models.summary: New text-to-speech models generate customizable, expressive voices and are rolling out in Google AI Studio and the Gemini API.

models.headline: Anthropic releases Claude Opus 5.5
models.summary: Anthropic says Opus 5.5 performs near Claude Fable 5.1 while costing 40 percent less, and it is available on major cloud platforms.

tools.headline: Claude used to identify a new CRISPR-like enzyme system
tools.summary: Anthropic's life sciences group reports that Claude helped find array-associated reverse transcriptases in bacteriophages.

tools.headline: Transformers library can now run llama.cpp GGUF quants
tools.summary: Hugging Face Transformers now loads quantized GGUF models and runs them efficiently on local machines, including Apple Silicon.

tools.headline: UK AISI adopts EvalEval format to share benchmark results
tools.summary: The UK AI Security Institute will publish evaluation results in a shared standard format to make benchmarks easier to reproduce.
